title: Enforce the documented bound on Travel Agent tool feedback
description:
Owner authorization: find the Travel Agent requirements and have AI Factory implement documented missing behavior. This is the first bounded slice, not permission to implement all historical audits or deploy the app.

Repository: Dzikle/ai-travel-agent (Wayfinder). Start from the Paperclip project source pinned at fc5d95c2ce0e3606b26dc1d0f954143389cdcbdc; work only in your assigned task worktree. The operator did not modify app code.

Read these current requirements before changing code: docs/architecture/ai-agent.md (Runtime boundary, Grounded synthesis, Structured response, Fallback and degradation); docs/architecture/tool-contracts.md (Grounding boundary and Failure semantics); docs/testing/agent-grounding.md; docs/testing/conversation-evals.md. The old docs/audits/iterative-agent-loop-audit.md describes an earlier single-call implementation, but the bounded iterative loop now exists. Do not rebuild it or treat the old audit as current missing functionality. README and current source/status supersede historical integration claims.

Observed gap at the pinned source: packages/agent/src/index.ts defines MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS = 7500. compactToolResult checks JSON.stringify(payload).length once; its oversize fallback discards result and retains up to twelve groundedFacts plus an unbounded error without checking the final serialized size. A single long fact/error string, JSON escaping or unicode-heavy provider text can therefore defeat the per-tool bound. compactValue also returns deep values unchanged, so inspect nested/preserved option fields. The separate maxModelInputChars guard is not a substitute for a valid bounded tool JSON message or retained follow-up identifiers. Reproduce this through runAgentTurn and a deterministic fake WORKING provider, not a real model/travel provider.

Allowed changes: packages/agent/src/index.ts; tests/agent-working.test.ts; docs/architecture/ai-agent.md. Keep any helper private in the existing agent package. No dependency, lockfile, model-provider, API, persistence, Expo UI, infrastructure, Factory/controller or permission changes. Do not change MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS, global budgets, five-step default, one repair limit, duplicate-call policy or allowlist merely to make tests pass.

Execution steps:
1. Inspect existing AgentToolRegistry and FakeWorkingAiModelProvider tests. Add failing public runAgentTurn regressions that capture actual role=tool messages in the second provider request. Use the real registry with controlled deterministic tool outputs/errors, or double only that service boundary. Assert JSON.parse succeeds; content.length <= 7500; tool/status and message toolCallId remain correct; returned raw toolExecutions/facts preserve deterministic originals. Observe RED before the fix.
2. Cover one oversized grounded-fact string, twelve oversized fact strings, an oversized operational error, quotes/backslashes/newlines affecting serialized size, Macedonian/unicode text, and a deeply nested/large option field. Normal small feedback must retain ordinary option IDs and values. Oversize search feedback should retain a small bounded set of exact follow-up option identifiers when representable, rather than dropping every ID while claiming they are preserved. Do not cut a fact/numeric claim in half and pass it off as grounded; omit complete facts or emit an explicit bounded truncation diagnostic. If no safe detail fits, return a minimal valid envelope, with deterministic originals kept outside model-facing context.
3. Implement the smallest robust compaction/serialization correction and recheck the final serialized representation, including escaping and metadata overhead. Keep the orchestrator/provider/registry interfaces and deterministic fallback behavior unchanged. Do not make the model-facing envelope a new canonical fact source. Add concise documentation of the real per-tool bound and omission behavior.
4. Run the focused tests (pnpm exec vitest run tests/agent-working.test.ts tests/agent-tools.test.ts tests/agent-conversation.test.ts), then actual pnpm test, pnpm typecheck and pnpm migrations:check after pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts. These are credential-free fixture/static checks; do not run db:migrate or live/infra opt-in suites. Record actual commands, failures/skips and results, never infer app health from Factory Python checks.
5. Commit only the allowed files on your native task branch, leave it clean, and hand off baseGitHead/gitHead/gitTree plus RED/GREEN evidence using your run-scoped native stage decision. Separate Tests, Reviewer and QA must examine the same candidate; owner approval remains last.

Stop conditions: if the source revision/scope is wrong, dependencies fail, the requested behavior requires unrelated changes, or checks fail, record the concrete blocker and do not waive gates or silently broaden scope. No reads of environment/auth files, other repositories or owner credentials. No live providers, booking/payment calls, new services, Docker changes, push, shared-branch merge, deployment or owner-approval impersonation. Use existing Paperclip run/task authority only; no scripts that advance other agents' stages.
